title: Upgrade fetcher parsing and native account field reconciliation
completion_summary: Parsed native regular/algo Orderly orders and switched account math to native fee/liquidation/notional fields
acceptance_criteria: Fetcher parsing distinguishes regular orders from algo/conditional orders using the task 01 model contract.
Position, funding, liquidation, and fee values prefer Orderly-native response fields where practical instead of local estimates.
REST synchronization preserves Decimal precision for quantities, fees, pnl, and leverage-related values.
Validation steps for parser changes are documented through targeted parser assertions or fixtures prepared for the test task.
